decisions.reason: The signature-insertion requirement is already fully represented by the candidate's message 96 MODIFY, and its existing CANVA scope requires no further change.
The conditional relocation of the two favorite photographs is already fully represented by the candidate's message 96 MODIFY.
Signature insertion and relocation of letter photographs do not change the required biography count, appendix section, or biography integration method.
Relocating photographs to another proposal section if necessary does not authorize reordering the fixed RFQ section sequence.
The source changes the letter layout and photograph placement, not required narrative sections or the unresolved inclusion of Section 6.
The source does not change the inclusion, replacement count, or source of proposal tables.
The one-page constraint applies specifically to the proposal letter and does not change the separate overall RFQ page-limit or document-compaction requirements.
The source does not change whether the proposal includes a table of contents.
The source does not change the requirement to incorporate the organization chart into the final draft.
The source specifies changes to the independently tracked proposal-letter layout and required-photo placement; it does not alter the general full-document layout strategy.
The ability to insert a signature in the current Canva proposal does not resume or modify the deferred modular reusable-template requirement.
The source does not change the Agua Arc brand identity, logo source, or color source.
